title: A key for MeteoAlarm's archive (an account in someone's name)
summary: MeteoAlarm's archive, where Madeira's Tuesday-afternoon warnings could be looked for, needs a key: a free MeteoGate account and API key, or a token asked of MeteoAlarm as a re-distributor. Either is an account in someone's name: yours to decide.
closes: Your yes with a named account holder, or your no.
blocks: Warnings that left the live feed before we first read it (Madeira before 01:50 on Wednesday) cannot be recovered.

sources.starts: Dinis: MeteoAlarm's archive (where Madeira's Tuesday-afternoon warning
sources.full: Dinis: MeteoAlarm's archive (where Madeira's Tuesday-afternoon warnings can be looked for) needs a key: a free MeteoGate account and API key (devportal.meteogate.eu), or a token asked of MeteoAlarm as a re-distributor. Either is an account in someone's name: your decision. With a key, it goes in the environment's network secrets, never in git.
